why: LANDED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 C8): rclcpp's `Publisher::publish(const SerializedMessage &)`, named for what it takes because a `(data, len)` overload of `publish` beside `publish(const M &)` would be ambiguous to read. ENVELOPE (stated on the member): the payload is a `(data, len)` pair, not an `rclcpp::SerializedMessage`, which owns a growable buffer through an allocator (`cpp:SerializedMessage` is a divergence for that reason). The receive side's word is already `take_serialized`. Replaces `publish_raw`, kept one release behind `NROS_CPP_DEPRECATED_MSG`.
